# Netting set (`netting-set` v1)

Trades that net on close-out under one agreement and CSA, with exposure and collateral.

**Group:** Exposure and capital · **Mnemonic:** `NSET` · **Identifiers:** `NS-…` in `nettingSetId`

Open one with `NSET <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: netting-set
version: 1
description: "Trades that net on close-out under one agreement and CSA, with exposure and collateral."
match: { kind: netting-set, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Exposure and capital · Netting set, id: $.nettingSetId }
strip:
  - { label: Trades, bind: $.tradeCount }
  - { label: Net MTM, bind: $.netMtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Collateral, bind: $.collateral, fmt: signed0 }
  - { label: EE peak, bind: $.eePeak, fmt: compact }
  - { label: PFE 95 peak, bind: $.pfePeak, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Limit, bind: $.limit, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Utilisation, bind: $.utilisation, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: CVA, bind: $.cva, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
panels:
  - id: exposure
    kind: area
    title: Exposure profile
    code: EXP
    key: F2
    rows: $.profile
    x: tenor
    limit: $.limit
    series:
      - { label: Expected exposure, value: ee, tone: link }
      - { label: PFE 95, value: pfe, tone: accent }
  - id: trades
    kind: table
    title: Member trades
    code: TRD
    key: F3
    rows: $.trades
    columns:
      - { label: Trade, bind: "@.tradeId" }
      - { label: Product, bind: "@.product" }
      - { label: Notional, bind: "@.notional", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Maturity, bind: "@.maturity", fmt: date }
      - { label: MTM, bind: "@.mtm", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
  - id: byAsset
    kind: hbar
    title: Net MTM by asset class
    area: right
    rows: $.byAsset
    label: asset
    value: mtm
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.counterparty, 'counterparty')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
